versions.changelog:
Initial release: turns a structured carousel script into PNG slides ready for Instagram, applying the FÓRMULA 100K brandkit.

- Renders visual slides (PNG, 1080×1350, 2x) using either default editorial dark or scrapbook style if requested.
- Injects user's real photos in several preset compositions (polaroid, hero background, cutout, strip) when specified.
- Reads handle, CTA word, and offer from user profile and data folders to personalize slides.
- Delivers output via Telegram as uncompressed PNG files, arranged and named properly.
- Enforces composition variation and brandkit rules for a professional, visually consistent result.
- Strictly for rendering — does not write scripts, only visual output from existing carousel scripts.
